Early Medieval human remains

Adult female. Cranium, mandible, maxilla, teeth, sternum, clavicle, scapula, vertebrae, ribs, L and R humerus, L and R ulna, L and R radius, L and R femur, L and R tibia, L and R patella, carpals, tarsals, metacarpals, metatarsals, phlanages. Cribra orbitalia, cortical defects. Tibia belonging to another individual.

Collection Area

Archaeology & Numismatics

Item Number

95.56H/1.474

Find Information

Site Name: Great House Farm, Llandough

Grid Reference: ST 1681 7331
Collection Method: excavation
Date: 1994

Notes: Plain grave. Crounched - legs folded to chest, arms crossed on chest.

Acquisition

donation, 28/7/1994
Should any artefacts be placed on display in any museum, then Ideal Homes Wales Ltd. should be acknowledged as the donor.
